component.name: YAGF 2
component.summary: Local OCR studio for scanned documents

description.p: Open scanned images, PDFs and DjVu documents, recognize text with Tesseract, and correct words against the source page. Edit page regions and reading order, convert DjVu to PDF, then export text, structured data, and searchable PDFs.

Compare OCR pipelines on verified calibration and held-out pages, inspect saved readings and resource measurements, and run reproducible desktop or Jetson benchmarks. Improve photographed scans with orientation correction and adaptive binarization.
Document-wide verification queue, correction retention across OCR reruns, and configurable or adaptive PDF and DjVu rendering resolution.
